name: dt
basis: assumption: navigation telemetry delivered to the mission computer at 1 Hz

name: duration
basis: assumption: one scenario is a 5-minute flight segment

name: gnss_pos_sigma_x
basis: assumption: white noise per axis; 2.45 sigma (95 % of a circular 2-D error) = 8 m, the order of the GPS SPS Performance Standard (5th ed., 2020) global-average horizontal accuracy

name: gnss_pos_sigma_h
basis: assumption: white noise; 1.96 sigma = 13 m, the order of the GPS SPS Performance Standard (5th ed., 2020) global-average vertical accuracy

name: gnss_vel_sigma
basis: assumption: Doppler-derived velocity noise of a navigation-grade receiver

name: ins_acc_sigma
basis: assumption: accelerometer white noise of one 1 s sample (after attitude resolution)

name: ins_bias_sigma
basis: assumption: per-unit constant accelerometer bias, about 1 mg (tactical-grade order of magnitude, error model of Groves 2013 ch. 4)

name: baro_sigma
basis: assumption: barometric altitude noise after filtering

name: onset_min
basis: assumption: earliest anomaly onset (leaves 100 s of clean history)

name: onset_max
basis: assumption: latest anomaly onset (leaves at least 100 s of anomaly)
